results.title: German Firms Rely On US Tech Despite Growing Fears Of Digital Dependence
results.description: German companies remain heavily dependent on US technology, from cloud services and software to AI. A new survey reveals why businesses see the reliance as risky but are reluctant to pay the cost of switching. Meanwhile, the EU is racing to build its own AI infrastructure.#Germany #US #Technology #AI #Europe #EU #ArtificialIntelligence #TechRace
